criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: The cover is the best frame, with true blacks and a clear focal rack at 432 px; 6 and 9 carry the staged rack well; reliefs 3, 4, 5, 7 measured. Frame 8 crate reads as a nightstand, frame 2 tray walls never show and is top-loaded, frame 3 shot straight on reads as a flat chart, frame 5 reuses frame 4's camera.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One deck on the contact sheet: near-black field, same type, Frontera steel/copper vs Vista cyan colour code, the tray motif changes state 1 to 3 to 6 to 7 to 9. Frames 4 and 5 sit outside the hardware world; frame 8's warm wood comes from nowhere.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral checked traces to a claim; the Vista comparison is hedged on every surface; molecules labelled drawn to illustrate. Spine rests on HPCwire reprints of TACC releases since tacc.utexas.edu was excluded. No hard fail.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: Clear what happened, but no decision or decider, no date for Horizon's full production, UT Southwestern unplaced, the stake implied rather than stated; caption ends on an abstract question.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns the swipe; frame 2 detours to retirement; 64 vs 8 repeats on 1, 3, 7, 9; real turn on 6 well placed; 5 could merge into 4; close summarises.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean, exact, on register with good lines; careful to stiffness, hedge repeated three times, process narration line in caption, Texas detail stops at institution names.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: New subject and molecular relief vocabulary; opening register familiar; ledgers not counted line by line.

one_sentence_fix: Give the reader a concrete stake and next step: replace frame 8's ambiguous crate and the abstract closing question with a sourced fact about Horizon, and make frame 2 pay the cover's 64 versus 8 contrast at once.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Wooden crate reads as a nightstand at feed size; warm wood outside the steel and cyan vocabulary; cables trail into a dead lower left.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Model Horizon as the deck's own rack, half populated, a few trays sliding in, empty slots dark.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Copper sinks fill the width, no tray wall shows, lower third dead.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Pull the camera back and lower it so one full tray with walls and both sinks sits in the pool, shadow into the bottom third.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: 64-tray wall straight on reads as a flat chart; carrier tight under the dek.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Rake the view and drop the carrier 120 px so tray depth and casts show.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Reuses frame 4's vesicle and bilayer from nearly the same camera.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Crop tight on the fusion site so joined interiors and four SNAREs fill a third to half the frame.
